question: If Mark weighs 150 pounds and Susan weighs 20 pounds less than Mark.  And their friend Bob weighs twice as much as Susan.  What is the average weight of the 3 friends?

note: Recorded with greedy decoding, thinking on, and the paper's GSM8K prompt. A forward pass is one pass of a 4B model. Autoregressive decoding emits one token per pass. With the DFlash drafter (OPD-trained, 15 proposals, strict verification) each verification pass keeps the accepted drafted tokens plus one; the drafter's own small passes are not counted. QwenDLM + ORL counts every denoising step of its 256-token blocks plus one cache commit per block; undecided canvas positions show characters of the tokens they hold, fitted to each final token's width. All three final answers match the reference answer (180).
